title: Jensen Huang Reinstated: Dramatic Reversal in Nvidia's Board Within a Week, Stock Price Surges 31% in Response
excerpt: A tug-of-war over who would hold the highest power at NVIDIA was completely reversed in less than a week. The NVIDIA board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen
content_html:
A tug-of-war over who would hold the highest power at NVIDIA was completely reversed in less than a week. The NVIDIA board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and director, and the stock price immediately surged 31% after the announcement. Just days earlier, things had looked entirely different—Chairman Harvey Jones had explicitly told investors that the board had no intention of bringing him back.

What brought about this reversal was several forces falling into place at once. The board explained that follow-up talks left them satisfied with Jensen Huang's candor; at the same time, senior U.S. government officials assured the board that his return did not pose a national security risk; President Trump also publicly voiced support for the decision. With these three endorsements, the decision that had once shut Jensen Huang out was undone by the same people who had made it.

Jensen Huang's statement after returning to NVIDIA headquarters was widely quoted: "I hope for a second chance. The second time, I will be a better CEO." After a brief period of turmoil, the world's most valuable chip company was back in the hands of its founder and helmsman—and the capital market cast its vote with a 31% gain.
